title: In kvm_vfio_pviommu_attach of vfio.c, there is a possible double free due to a logic error in the code. (CVE-2026-58847)
description: A logic error in the kvm_vfio_pviommu_attach function of vfio.c can cause a double free vulnerability. This flaw allows local users to escalate privileges without needing additional execution privileges or user interaction.
